description: Implement Scene010 Arrival - the first human-scale scene with ArrivalDirector, spatial compression, environmental quieting, camera settling, and Engine integration
steps: 1. Add ARRIVAL_STATES constant to js/config/constants.js following the JOURNEY_STATES pattern. States: APPROACH, PRESENCE, STILLNESS, ANTICIPATION, ARRIVAL.

2. Add scene010 config block to js/config/settings.js (Object.freeze) following scene009 pattern. Include: arrival (speed: 0.00015 - even slower than journey, settlingDuration: 6, compressionRate: 0.02, reducedMotionFactor: 0.3), phases (approach: {start:0, duration:9}, presence: {start:9, duration:9}, stillness: {start:18, duration:9}, anticipation: {start:27, duration:9}, arrival: {start:36, duration:9}), environment (driftReduction: 0.85, particleDamping: 0.4, ambientFade: 0.5, focusEnhancement: 0.6, compressionTarget: 0.7), lighting (warmthTarget: 0.12, presenceGlow: 0.04), connection (breathDepth: 0.3, microVariation: 0.008, meaningfulnessRate: 0.02).

3. Create js/engine/universe/ArrivalDirector.js - a lightweight, arrival-only director (NOT generic). Constructor pre-allocates state object. Methods: init(canvasW, canvasH, connectionMidX, connectionMidY, config), update(deltaTime, pool, activeCount, cameraController), getCompressionFactor(), getQuietingFactor(), getSettlingProgress(). Responsibilities: (a) spatial compression - reduce perceived distance by pulling particles slightly toward connection midpoint (not geometric zoom), (b) environmental quieting - dampen particle velocities globally, reduce ambient drift multiplier, (c) settling - exponential decay of remaining movement toward rest. Must be under 400 lines, no function over 60 lines, zero allocations.

4. Create js/scenes/scene010/Scene010Phases.js following the Scene009Phases.js pattern exactly. Export buildScene010Phases(scene) returning 5 phases: Approach, Presence, Stillness, Anticipation, Arrival. Each phase calls scene methods for (a) updating connection meaningfulness (subtle breathing enhancement), (b) advancing spatial compression via ArrivalDirector, (c) reducing environmental motion, (d) settling camera drift, (e) increasing focus/warmth. The final phase (Arrival) calls scene.markCompleted() in onLeave. Export SCENE010_DURATION = 45.

5. Create js/scenes/Scene010_Arrival.js following Scene009_Descent.js pattern exactly. Class with standard lifecycle (getId, setUniverse, load, enter, update, leave, destroy). Reuses: GravityCenter (subtle coherence), ConnectionRenderer (one filament, enhanced breathing), RecognitionEngine (maintained ~0.55), MemoryEngine (maintained ~0.25), AudioArchitecture (register arrival_complete, presence_established, first_human_moment - emit only, no playback), SceneDirector (5 phases), LightingEngine (via setWarmthOffset), CameraController (via setTarget, setDriftMultiplier). NEW: instantiates ArrivalDirector. Key behaviors: (a) camera driftMultiplier starts at Scene009's ending value (~0.03) and reduces to near 0.01, (b) ArrivalDirector compresses spatial perception, (c) environmental quieting reduces particle velocities, (d) connection filament gets enhanced breathing (slightly deeper, slower oscillation via a scene-level multiplier passed as progress to ConnectionRenderer), (e) reduced motion path: skip camera settling, communicate via opacity/composition/lighting only.

6. Modify js/engine/Engine.js: (a) import Scene010_Arrival, (b) add scene010Registered/scene010Instance constructor fields, (c) add initScene010() method following initScene009 pattern, (d) call this.initScene010() in init() after initScene009(), (e) add Scene009->Scene010 completion-based transition check in checkSceneTransition(), (f) add transitionToScene010() async method following transitionToScene009 pattern (pass connection data, set skipEnvironmentTeardown on scene009Instance).
7. Validate all new and modified files with NODE_OPTIONS="" node --check to confirm zero syntax errors.
acceptance_criteria: js/engine/universe/ArrivalDirector.js exists, is under 400 lines, all methods under 60 lines, zero per-frame allocations
js/scenes/Scene010_Arrival.js exists, follows the Scene009 pattern, reuses existing systems, has proper lifecycle
js/scenes/scene010/Scene010Phases.js exists with 5 phases matching the emotional arc
js/config/constants.js contains ARRIVAL_STATES with correct values
js/engine/Engine.js imports Scene010, registers it, has transition logic from Scene009
All files pass node --check syntax validation
No new rendering pipeline created - reuses ConnectionRenderer, LightingEngine, etc.
No UI, Earth, globe, phone, logo, typography, product, app screen, chat, human figures in any new code
Audio events registered but never trigger playback (muted system)
verification: Run NODE_OPTIONS="" node --check on each new/modified file
Verify ArrivalDirector.js line count is under 400
Verify no function in any new file exceeds 60 lines
Grep for forbidden concepts (UI, phone, Earth, globe, logo, chat, Hero) in new files
